The JavaScript/TypeScript client provides full access to TerminusDB's version-control operations — clone, branch, reset, squash, time travel, and diff/patch. Use these guides to manage collaborative workflows programmatically from Node.js or browser environments.

* [Clone with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/clone-a-project/)
* [Branch with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/branch-howto/)
* [Reset with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/reset-a-project/)
* [Squash with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/squash-projects/)
* [Time Travel with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/time-travel-howto/)
* [Diff & Patch with JS](https://terminusdb.org/docs/diff-and-patch-operations/)
